text:
devon: Heads up — seeing a sustained reconcile spike from controller-manager in eu-central1 starting ~12:34 UTC. GPU provisioning backlog climbing and some Pods stuck Pending. apiserver SLOs flirting with 500s. anyone looking?

maria: on it, pulling events now. did we just roll something to node-autoscaler?

raj: i rolled the ASG scaling policy earlier for cost test, but no ongoing deploys from infra.

k8s-ops-bot: [alert] controller-manager leader change detected (old: controller-01 -> new: controller-03). reconcile_rate: 780 rps (1m avg).

sam: paste of `kubectl get events --all-namespaces --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp | tail -n 40` shows a lot of "Node/Pod update" events and repeated `cordon`/`uncordon` from kubelet.

devon: exact logs from controller-manager:
```
I0901 12:34:35.123456 1 controller_manager.go:512] starting controller manager (leader-election: enabled)
I0901 12:34:35.223456 1 leaderelection.go:243] successfully acquired lease kube-system/controller-manager-controller-0
I0901 12:34:36.523456 1 sync.go:98] Reconciler "node" processing update for node gpu-az3-node-12
I0901 12:34:36.623456 1 sync.go:99] Reconciler "node" processing update for node gpu-az3-node-12
...repeated tens of times per second...
```

maria: looks like a noisy node causing churn (kubelet flapping cordon state). when controller-manager gets hammered it kicks off leader handoffs and lease renewals which in turn pressure apiserver.

oncall: i can temporarily fence the node and drain it to stop events. should we do that?

devon: yes please cordon+drain gpu-az3-node-12. also increase controller-manager replica priority to avoid leader thrash while we stabilize.

raj: cordon/drain command: `kubectl cordon gpu-az3-node-12 && kubectl drain gpu-az3-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`

sam: doing drain now. patching controller-manager pod spec to increase resources and set leader-elect leaseDuration to 15s -> 30s to reduce flipiness.

k8s-ops-bot: deployment patch applied to controller-manager (image: redwood/controller-manager:v2.3.1-safety). rolling restart started.

maria: after drain the event rate dropped ~85% and reconcile queue backlog started to clear. GPU provisioning queue (internal metric) went from 420 -> 60 in ~4m. apiserver 5xxs falling.

devon: next actions: 1) investigate kubelet logs on gpu-az3-node-12 for flapping root cause (network hiccup vs kubelet OOM), 2) evaluate autoscaler policy test that raj ran, 3) add short-term admission control on GPU provisioning to cap create-rate until we have stable leader.

raj: ack. i'll revert the ASG policy to previous state and run a canary against staging.

sam: I'll open a follow-up runbook PR with a pre-baked playbook: cordon/drain -> bump leaseDuration -> restart controller-manager -> monitor reconcile_rate & apiserver_5xx.

maria: logs from kubelet on node show repeated health check failures toward the node-proxy, likely due to intermittent MTU mismatch after an upstream peering change. sending to network team.

devon: thanks. marking incident as mitigated for now. leaving follow-ups for root cause. :thumbsup:

oncall: incident note: Mitigated by draining noisy node + controller-manager stabilization. GPU provisioning backlog cleared. Will track RCA with networking & autoscaler owners.
